note: 18 targeted follow-up controls; overlap existing W1/owner cases and are not additional passed tests or a complete consumer suite

cases.trigger: Same compiled environment and live operation
cases.expected: Capture is bound to the exact executable/environment; foreign/closed operations refuse before source getters.
Separate match/global roles, unique admission leasing and source-free named templates retain correct context during capture.
Detached managed serialized bytes, URIs/properties and production order match the supported capture contract; no filesystem output.
Message count, secondary count, per-output and total-byte bounds apply at production with expected classified outcomes; no total-memory claim.
Completed outputs survive subsequent transform/serialization failure with correct failure classification; principal-only serialization is insufficient.
Raw cancellation/operation/time controls compose explicitly and preserve Cancelled/Partial/Failed semantics; compilation and between-checkpoint limits remain documented.
Actual per-run denial/unsupported-route receipts remain attributable and isolated across runs; state/test redaction before publication/IPC.
Actual admitted resources stay held until all captured output/result consumption completes; canceling a wait does not release early.
Mutable options are copied/refused under selected profile; invocation/context precedence, raw-result exclusions and unsupported fields never silently fall back.
Capture/serialization plus multiple cleanup failures preserve all objects/order; measure warm/cold allocations/latency under identified fixtures without claiming owner budgets.

cases.trigger: Generation acquisition failure plus release failure
cases.expected: Original failure and cleanup failure survive; owner fault state is established even if release throws.

cases.trigger: Epoch acquisition plus two cleanup failures
cases.expected: Original then generation/admission cleanup failures are preserved in reverse-acquisition attempt order.
Distinguish fail-before-release and fail-after-release; no blind retry, duplicate release or unproven reclamation guarantee.
Hold actual BeginRead/native generation ownership through raw work, partial consumption and canceled waits; normal and fault paths are separated.
Refuse unsupported same-owner overlap/reentry before getters; admission close defers actual disposal until raw completion.
Clarify and qualify sequential handoff between operation-entry thread and dedicated transform worker; do not accidentally require an incompatible thread-affinity rule.
Provider-local actual snapshot checks reject throwing foreign nodes and same labels in another snapshot without traversal/copy or schema authority.
Unchanged source/binary, identity/order/namespaces/defaults/typed-value policy and store-format invariants are checked against one candidate; no history deletion or implicit pin change.
